_about: The facts about one state that this code would otherwise carry in many places. A fork for another state edits this file; src/lib/state_settings.py reads it, and nothing else should repeat a fact that is here (preflight fails on a second county list). WHAT A FORK STILL CHANGES, beyond this file: (1) the General Court's page addresses, field labels and file formats in src/fetch/ and src/parse/, which are written against gc.nh.gov and its database; (2) the term arithmetic (term_of in src/lib/proceedings.py and a dozen copies of 'an odd year starts a term') and the Organization Day rule, which are computed in code and only described here; (3) the bill-kind lists, which three modules keep in their own orders (src/fetch/gc_web/fetch_legislation.py, src/pages/bill_order.py, src/parse/journal_bills.py); (4) the time zone as written in JavaScript (src/pages/app.js, live.js, workers/); (5) 'New Hampshire', 'General Court', 'RSA' and 'NH' in page text, the guides and the Learn pages, and the Spanish drafts; (6) district numbering, the county-and-district labels (Hills 22) and the 400 and 24 seat counts quoted in prose; (7) the Secretary of State, county and town sources under src/towns/ and src/ops/state_sources.py; (8) the logo, the domain in wrangler.toml and the email follow Workers.

term.note: The rule is computed in code; these are its parameters for a reader and a fork.
